youtube.title: How approval works for Google posts | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How approval works in Posts & Photos in ConstructHUB: a typed or AI-drafted post stays a draft, a draft batch keeps several posts to approve together, and Approve & queue post is what authorizes publishing at the scheduled times. A queued post can still be cancelled.
